children.label: impact_evaluation
children.description: Assesses the long-term effects of humanitarian interventions on the target population, focusing on outcomes and changes brought about by the intervention.

children.label: process_evaluation
children.description: Examines the implementation and delivery of humanitarian programs, identifying strengths and weaknesses in the processes and procedures used.
example_papers: Evaluation of the Government of  Seychelles & United Nations  Strategic Partnership Framework (SPF) 2019-2023

children.label: formative_evaluation
children.description: Conducted during the planning and early stages of a humanitarian intervention to improve the design and implementation of the program.
example_papers: Mid-term evaluation of the project "Upscaling climate resilience measures in the Dry Corridor agroecosystems of El Salvador (RECLIMA)"

children.label: real_time_evaluation
children.description: Provides immediate feedback during the course of a humanitarian response, allowing for timely adjustments and improvements to the intervention.

children.label: cost_effectiveness_analysis
children.description: Evaluates the economic efficiency of humanitarian interventions by comparing the costs of different programs to their outcomes, aiming to maximize the benefits per unit of cost.
